title: 2 nodes run more than one DCGM exporter

fix.summary: DCGM's profiling counters allow one client per GPU, so these break each other. Keep DaemonSet/gke-managed-system/dcgm-exporter and remove DaemonSet/monitoring/dcgm-exporter. forge touches neither.

title: 1 node reports unhealthy accelerators
evidence: Node/gke-inference-g2-pool-1: allocatable 0 of capacity 1 nvidia.com/gpu (1 withheld by the device plugin)

fix.summary: The device plugin stopped offering a device it reports unhealthy. Cordon the node (`kubectl cordon gke-inference-g2-pool-1`), drain it when its work allows, then reset the device or open an RMA with the vendor.

title: Xid, ECC or row-remap counters are not collected: failing GPUs go unnoticed
evidence: DaemonSet/gke-managed-system/dcgm-exporter (3.3.5-3.4.0-gke.3): no XID_ERRORS, ECC_SBE, ECC_DBE, UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, ROW_REMAP_FAILURE; field set from GKE managed DCGM metric set (cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/how-to/dcgm-metrics, 2026-11-26)
DaemonSet/monitoring/dcgm-exporter (4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04): no ECC_SBE, ECC_DBE; field set from dcgm-exporter 4.2.3-4.1.3 etc/dcp-metrics-included.csv (default of 4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04)

fix.summary:
DaemonSet/gke-managed-system/dcgm-exporter: GKE's managed DCGM metric set is fixed and cannot export Xid, ECC or row-remap counters. GKE node auto-repair acts on GPU faults; to collect these fields, run NVIDIA's dcgm-exporter instead of (never beside) the managed collection.

DaemonSet/monitoring/dcgm-exporter uses its image's built-in counters file (dcgm-exporter 4.2.3-4.1.3 etc/dcp-metrics-included.csv (default of 4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04)). Mount a counters CSV with these lines added and point the exporter at it (-f <path>, or DCGM_EXPORTER_COLLECTORS):
DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total number of single-bit volatile ECC errors.
DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total number of double-bit volatile ECC errors.
forge never edits an exporter it did not install.

title: The DCGM exporter exports only coarse utilisation: profiling counters (SM, tensor, DRAM activity) are off
evidence: DaemonSet/monitoring/dcgm-exporter (4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04): no PROF_SM_ACTIVE, PROF_SM_OCCUPANCY; field set from dcgm-exporter 4.2.3-4.1.3 etc/dcp-metrics-included.csv (default of 4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04)

fix.summary:
DaemonSet/monitoring/dcgm-exporter uses its image's built-in counters file (dcgm-exporter 4.2.3-4.1.3 etc/dcp-metrics-included.csv (default of 4.2.3-4.1.3-ubuntu22.04)). Mount a counters CSV with these lines added and point the exporter at it (-f <path>, or DCGM_EXPORTER_COLLECTORS):
DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE, gauge, The ratio of cycles an SM has at least 1 warp assigned.
DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_OCCUPANCY, gauge, The ratio of number of warps resident on an SM.
forge never edits an exporter it did not install.

title: 1 workload runs accelerators with the 64 MiB /dev/shm default
evidence: Deployment/search/embedder: 1 pod, container embedder mounts no memory emptyDir at /dev/shm

fix.summary: Mount an emptyDir {medium: Memory} (with a sizeLimit) at /dev/shm in each accelerator container: NCCL, PyTorch DataLoader workers and vLLM's tensor parallelism need more than 64 MiB.

title: 1 accelerator image is not warm on every node of its pool
evidence: ghcr.io/acme/embedder:1.4: not on gke-inference-g2-pool-1 (pool g2-pool; present on 1 of 2 nodes)
node.status.images lists at most 50 images per node by default, so a busy node may hold an image it does not list

fix.summary: Pre-pull the image on the pool (a pre-pull DaemonSet, kube-fledged), or bake it into the node image (GKE: a secondary boot disk), so a new pod does not wait for the pull.

title: No continuous profiling on the accelerator nodes

fix.summary: Run one continuous eBPF profiler as a DaemonSet on the accelerator nodes: Parca agent, Grafana Alloy with pyroscope.ebpf, or the OpenTelemetry eBPF profiler (otel/opentelemetry-collector-ebpf-profiler). It shows where CPU time goes in data loaders and serving code with no code change.
Install an OpenTelemetry Collector with an otlp receiver (grpc :4317, http :4318) so vLLM, Triton and training jobs can export traces and metrics.

title: Image volumes are unavailable: weights cannot be mounted from an OCI artifact without a sidecar
evidence: API server v1.32.2-gke.1182003: the ImageVolume feature gate is on by default from Kubernetes 1.35

fix.summary: Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.35+ with containerd 2.1+ to mount weights as an image volume. Until then, KServe's modelcar sidecar or an init-container copy is the fallback.
